title: Hilarious footage of grumpy cat rejecting kitten with growls and hisses
description:
Hilarious footage has emerged of a cat clearly rejecting the idea that 'Sharing is Caring.'

The comical clip shared by Cassidy shows her dramatic older cat hissing and growling at the mere sight of a kitten.

The grumpy kitty is in no mood to care for a kitten she didn’t give birth to and doesn’t hesitate to show her annoyance.

Meanwhile, the kitten remains unbothered and continues her day without any unnecessary drama.
Location: La Verne, United States
